basis: Immunodeficiency with common ectodermal skin/sweat abnormalities; developmental dental defects affect >30%. Osteopetrosis is confined to an uncommon subtype.
Congenital atrioventricular septal and valve malformation; respiratory symptoms do not establish direct lung damage.
Segmental autonomic sympathetic dysfunction; flushing and sweating abnormalities do not establish intrinsic skin damage.
Prion disease causing progressive cerebral neurodegeneration; prion mechanism supports infectious_immune.
Muscular dystrophy, early contractures and cardiac disease form the defining triad; diminished reflexes reflect myopathy rather than separate nerve damage.
Inherited melanin/melanosome disorder with foveal hypoplasia and impaired vision; freckling and giant melanosomes do not establish damaging skin disease.
Interstitial 20q deletion syndromes commonly include developmental impairment; absent interval and phenotype details prevent reliable additional organ assignments.
Bone fragility, arterial rupture and deafness define syndrome; cataract/myopia in 1/1. Skin/nail and developmental/CNS defects omitted at four-axis cap; tiny cohort.
Malignancy located in the thalamus; endocrine involvement is not established for the overall concept.
Bile-acid synthesis disorder causes progressive cholestatic liver injury; malabsorption and coagulopathy reflect deficient bile and hepatic function rather than intrinsic gut or blood damage.
Inherited epidermal disorder with seborrhea-like dermatitis, acanthosis and hyperkeratosis; no established systemic immune disease.
Central autonomic ventilatory failure and intestinal aganglionosis define disease; hypoventilation does not establish intrinsic lung injury.
Congenital skin creases; intellectual disability 4/4 and callosal hypoplasia 2/2; microphthalmia 4/4; cleft palate 3/4. Other structural abnormalities individually below 30%.
Childhood glial or mixed glial-neuronal tumor arising in the central nervous system.
Thrombosis of a dural venous sinus; ear infection is a possible antecedent, and headache or raised intracranial pressure alone does not establish brain injury.
CD40L immunodeficiency; intrinsic neutropenia in 39/62 (~63%). Respiratory/CNS infections are separate diseases; cholangitis occurs in <30%.
Well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor arising in the cecum; neuroendocrine histology alone does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Inherited retinal disease caused by biallelic GPR179 variants; no established extraocular organ involvement.
Progressive bulbar motor neuron degeneration; dysphagia and muscle weakness reflect denervation rather than intrinsic gastrointestinal or skeletal muscle disease.
Isolated profound prelingual sensorineural hearing loss; the HGF gene name does not imply hepatic disease.
Immune-mediated localized skin fibrosis; deeper fascia, muscle, joint or bone involvement affects roughly 30% or more in linear disease. CNS and ocular injury are uncommon.
Congenital fusion of teeth; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Xq deletions commonly cause ovarian dysgenesis or insufficiency with endocrine failure; neurologic, renal and muscle involvement depends on the deleted interval.
Nonsyndromic inherited hearing loss, present in 3/3; other PNPT1-associated syndromes do not establish additional involvement here.
Asthma affects the bronchial airways and is explicitly mediated by type I hypersensitivity.
